decision: umn_ext 'Growing pumpkins and winter squash': "Plant pumpkin and winter squash seeds three-fourths of an inch deep, 24 to 36 inches apart. Use the closer spacing if the variety is a bush type. Spacing between rows should be 5 to 6 feet." -> row-none default, in_row [24,36], rows [60,72] (today [24,48]). D1 BLEND REPAIR (ruled): today's 48 is neither an in-row nor a row figure (the 2026-07-01 note: 'spans in-row plant spacing (24 in) to about a 4 ft row'). VCE 426-331 Table 5 ('Squash, winter 2-4 ft 3-10 ft'), also cited, would state 24-48, but the three winter squash take ONE page so the same species group reads the same figure, and UMN's sentence names winter squash and is the crop's own prose figure (vining 24-36, rows). Bush 18-24 is D2 (bush cucurbit spacings not authored this arc). Restatements: the two soil_prep rows '3 to 6 feet' -> '5 to 6 feet' (UMN), everything else agrees. No hill entry: the only hill figure on its cited pages is UGA C1206, a PUMPKIN page ('Plant pumpkins in hills, with at least 8 feet of space on all sides'), out of scope (worklist 56 §3).
